entities.summary: Alberts Šmits is a Latvian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for EHC Red Bull München of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga while under contract to Mikkelin Jukurit of the Liiga. He is regarded as a top prospect eligible for the 2026 NHL entry draft.
